items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And they would come and wake you up, Fletcher and he's in town, blowing. There was Rex and some of the guys, you know, and Hawk.

ctx.x: You got left on the outside for quite a little while.

And it was a funny thing about the difference between them and Fletcher. When Fletcher would come to town it would be mostly -- after they'd finished, I don't care what they were playing, there would be a jam session. So that would mean me and Peanuts Ho|land which was about the only two trumpet players that was playing all the spots. We had practically all the work, you know. And they would come and wake you up, Fletcher and he's in town, blowing. There was Rex and some of the guys, you know, and Hawk. And we'd…
But with Duke it never happened much.
